# Fixtures manifest

Every file under `tests/fixtures/` has a row here: its path from this folder, in backquotes, and where it came from (`build-plan.md` section 7, principle 4). `tests/t0_contract/test_fixtures_manifest.py` fails on a file with no row, or with an empty provenance.

Rules:

- No real client documents, in any form (`CLAUDE.md`, Hard constraints; `PROCESS.md` section 2). A fixture is invented, or written for this project.
- Real public documents, such as the court decisions of the experiments, stay outside the repository (`build-plan.md` section 7, "The held-out batch"). They are never a fixture.
- A fixture is never removed or made to ask less without Achia's decision (`CLAUDE.md`, Merging).

| Path | Provenance | Added in |
|---|---|---|
| `detect/credit_card.json` | Invented for this project: Hebrew sentences written by hand, with a slot for each number; `tests/invented_numbers.py` fills the slots when the tests run, with card numbers made from a fixed seed (its `SEED`, 32) by the Luhn check and the issuer prefixes of the card brands (valid ones of each brand, near misses with another check digit, numbers with no brand's prefix, a brand's prefix at a wrong length), so that no number that passes the check is stored (Achia, 2026-11-27, issue #32, "Make them fresh too (Recommended)": "Every later detector of a checksum type (cards, bank, companies) works the same way"); the numbers written as they are fail the check, or are sixteen zeros, or are no card's length; one negative's bank account triple is a slot filled from `BANK_NUMBERS` (issue #34; before, a literal); no real document | issue #35 |
| `detect/il_id.json` | Invented for this project: Hebrew sentences written by hand, with a slot for each number; `tests/invented_numbers.py` fills the slots when the tests run, with numbers made from a fixed seed (its `SEED`, 32) by the checksum of `build-plan.md` Phase 1 (valid ones, near misses with another check digit, company, non-profit, landline and case-number shapes), so that no number that passes the checksum is stored (Achia, 2026-11-27, issue #32, "Make them fresh too (Recommended)"); the trivial sequences the detector refuses (such as `000000000`) are written as they are; one negative's IBAN is a slot filled from `BANK_NUMBERS` (issue #34; before, a published example IBAN written as a literal); no real document | issue #32 |
| `detect/company_number.json` | Invented for this project: Hebrew sentences written by hand, with a slot for each number and the type each found slot must get; `tests/invented_numbers.py` fills the slots when the tests run, with numbers made from a fixed seed (its `SEED`, 32) by the checksum of `build-plan.md` Phase 1 (company numbers 51 to 54, non-profit numbers 58, IDs, near misses written by a slot's shape), so that no number that passes the checksum is stored (Achia, 2026-11-27, issue #32, "Make them fresh too (Recommended)"); the literals it holds fail the checksum (`555555555`, `512345678`) or are no nine-digit number; one negative's IBAN is a slot filled from `BANK_NUMBERS` (issue #34; before, a published example IBAN written as a literal); no real document | issue #33 |
| `detect/iban.json` | Invented for this project: Hebrew sentences written by hand, with a slot for each number, and for each item the slots it covers and its type; `tests/invented_numbers.py` fills the slots when the tests run, with numbers made from a fixed seed (its `SEED`, 32): IBANs completed with the check digits of ISO 7064 MOD 97-10, near misses, IBANs of other lengths and of another country, bank account triples, and IDs and registry numbers by the checksum of `build-plan.md` Phase 1, so that no number that passes a check is stored (Achia, 2026-11-27, issue #32, "Make them fresh too (Recommended)"); the literals it holds are dates, amounts, case numbers, a landline's area code and short numbers, no IBAN that passes the check (its T1 test checks that); three bank accounts the detector misses on purpose are listed apart, as known misses, each with its limit; no real document | issue #34 |
